summary: Frontend-only layout check of the Smart TV board (/display/production) at 1920x1080, 1366x768 and 1280x720, using DOM measurements and screenshots. At 1920x1080 everything passes. At 1366x768 and 1280x720 the chart in the right column spills out of <main> and covers the footer. In a client-side test (DOM edit, no data changed), realistic numbers like a 5-digit total or a 3-digit block qty got cut off with an ellipsis in the Sewing cards at 1366 and 1280 widths.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1366x768 the main area spans y=278-678 but the chart's bottom is at 780. At 1280x720 main spans 278-630 and the chart's bottom is 780. The chart sits on top of the footer (display-last-update / 'Line berproduksi') and runs off the screen. Cause: the PrintPack card is shrink-0 (264px), plus a 16px gap, plus the chart's min-h-[220px] = 500px, which is more than main's height (400 or 352px). The aside has min-h-0 but no overflow clipping, so the content overflows visibly.
Simulated total '12.345' with text-4xl: scrollWidth 132 vs clientWidth 113 at 1366 and 104 at 1280. It shows as '12.…' (clipped). Fine at 1920.
Simulated qty 128/45: text is 51px wide in a 50px box at 1366 and 45px at 1280. Shows as '128…' and the target is hidden. Fine at 1920.

issues: With only 2 lines, the Sewing panel leaves about 400px of empty space under the cards. Acceptable, but the cards could stretch or the grid cells could be bigger.

action_items: Make the right column fit inside main at smaller heights. Options: make the chart flex-1 min-h-0 (drop min-h-[220px] or use something like min-h-[120px]); and/or add overflow-hidden to the aside; and/or let the PrintPack card shrink and hide the product table on short screens (or use max-h with a scroll). Recheck at 1366x768 and 1280x720 that chart bottom <= main bottom < footer top.

Stop big numbers from truncating at 1280-1366 widths: use a smaller font for Stat values (for example text-3xl on narrow screens, or clamp()), or use fewer KPI columns. For block cells, use text-sm or drop the '/target' part when there isn't room, or use 4 columns.
critical_code_review_comments: DisplayBoard.tsx line 94: min-h-[220px] on the chart, together with the shrink-0 PrintPackCard (line 157), causes the overflow on short viewports.
Stat values use truncate, so overflow is hidden with an ellipsis instead of the text resizing. Numbers that get cut off are misleading on a production TV.
passed_checks: Exactly 1 display-panel-print-pack, and it contains display-panel-printing, display-panel-packing and display-print-pack-products (all 3 viewports)
display-block-chart top (560) is below the print-pack bottom (544), in the same x-range (all viewports)
Sewing line cards SEW-L1 and SEW-L2: bottom 594 is within the panel bottom; no clipped text with the current (zero) data; 20 block cells render
Header clock, 'TERHUBUNG', KPI row and footer are all visible with no overlap at 1920x1080; the page itself does not scroll
seed_data_creation: None. Large values were only simulated by editing the DOM in the browser.
